question: Create a 20-beat visual lesson explaining how transformer language models learn. Follow one running sentence from tokenization and embeddings through positional encoding, query-key-value attention, softmax, multi-head attention, residual and normalization layers, feed-forward blocks, next-token prediction, cross-entropy loss, backpropagation, gradient descent, learning-rate effects, training versus inference, and generalization. Return exactly 20 beats.

comparison.note: Native code generation and compilation are the unique native cost; artwork and storyboard variance also contribute.

caveats: Runs were sequential but not started from an identical OS/model cache state.
The browser-only lesson was reviewed at ~199s and later given continuous narration in a separate ~110s synchronization pass.
The native lesson was generated with TTS disabled after the long-script alignment failure; it currently plays with captions.
Browser narration required a fix: the aligner was given the whole lesson script as an initial prompt, which made Whisper skip the opening words of long recordings.
